class.name: NetwPredictDrive
class.brief_description: The result of asking a slot to drive one transition: whether it ran at all, and why not when it did not.
class.description: A slot's drive can refuse to open a transition for two unrelated reasons, and this record tells them apart rather than collapsing both to [method ran] being [code]false[/code]. [method clamped] means a frame-scheduled tick bought no simulated time at all, so no transition was owed. [method held] means the slot's speculation horizon is already full, so a transition exists to open but is deliberately delayed. Both leave [method transition] at [code]-1[/code] and [method kind] at [code]0[/code], the same as a freshly constructed record, so a caller checks [method ran] first before trusting any other member.

method.name: clamped
method.description: Whether this drive was refused because the tick bought no simulated time, the framed-schedule case where the clock held. The command lane keeps flowing even when this is [code]true[/code]; only the transition itself did not open.

method.name: fresh
method.description: Whether this transition carried a new command rather than repeating or holding the previous one. Meaningless unless [method ran] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: held
method.description: Whether this drive was refused because the slot's speculation horizon is already full. A transition remains owed; it is deferred rather than dropped.

method.name: kind
method.description: This transition's drive kind: [code]0[/code] none, [code]1[/code] fresh, [code]2[/code] a repeat, [code]3[/code] a hold, [code]4[/code] starved, [code]5[/code] a fold drive, [code]6[/code] missing, or [code]7[/code] substituted. Meaningless unless [method ran] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: label
method.description: The command label this transition was driven with, or [code]-1[/code] unless [method ran] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: ran
method.description: Whether this drive actually opened a transition. When [code]false[/code], check [method clamped] and [method held] for which refusal it was; every other member then answers its zero default rather than a real value.

method.name: transition
method.description: The transition this drive opened, or [code]-1[/code] unless [method ran] is [code]true[/code].
